subject: [PATCH v2] x86/mm: Remove the zapped-entry checks

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch removes the zapped-entry checks on x86 architecture, which were implemented to warn about shadow stack entries in VMAs without VM_SHADOW_STACK. The checks are only relevant when CONFIG_DEBUG_VM is enabled and the SRSO 'Safe RET' mitigation is active. Removing these checks improves performance by reducing branch mispredictions, resulting in a 6% speedup for MADV_DONTNEED of 1 GiB on anonymous memory and 8% on shmem, as well as a 5% improvement for munmap(). The patch also removes the pud_shstk() function, which had no other users.
